Title: ServiceNow Change Request List Filtering Workflow
Description: Steps to open the filter panel and sequentially add AND conditions for specific fields.
- Click the 'Show / hide filter' button to reveal the filter inputs.
- Open the field chooser combobox (labeled 'All of these conditions must be met. -- choose field --') for the first condition.
- Select the desired field (e.g., 'Type', 'Requested by', 'Model') from the dropdown list.
- Click the 'Choose option for field: [FieldName]' combobox to open the value selector.
- Set the operator (e.g., 'is empty string') or fill the text input with the required value.
- Click the 'Add AND Condition To Condition [N]: [Field] is [Value]' button to append the next condition.
- Repeat the process for remaining fields (Short description, State) until all criteria are met.
- Apply the filter after all conditions are configured.

Title: ServiceNow Filter Panel Interaction Patterns
Description: Key UI behaviors and potential failure points when building complex AND filters.
- The filter panel must be explicitly opened using the 'Show / hide filter' control before any conditions can be added.
- Field selection requires clicking the specific combobox for the current condition slot to reveal the list.
- Value selection may require using `select_option` on the combobox if direct clicking fails.
- New AND conditions are added via buttons labeled 'Add AND Condition To Condition [N]'.
- The operator selector for a field is a separate combobox that appears after the field is chosen.
- Empty string filters require selecting the 'is empty string' operator option from the operator menu.
- The 'Short description' field appears as a text input field for value entry.
- The 'State' field follows the same pattern as other fields but must be selected after the previous condition is added.
- The filter logic defaults to 'All of these conditions must be met' (AND) for the initial group.
- Failed clicks on dropdown options may require switching to the `select_option` method.
- The workflow stops if the 'Add AND Condition' button is not clicked after setting a field's value.
- Ensure the correct condition number (Condition 1, Condition 2, etc.) is tracked when adding multiple rows.
